(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); s.enemies.clear(true, true); return JSON.stringify({buttonsShown: s.touch.enabled, x: Math.round(s.player.x)}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({walkRight: s.touch.held.right, x: Math.round(s.player.x)}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({slidToLeft: s.touch.held.left && !s.touch.held.right, vx: Math.round(s.player.body.velocity.x)}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({released: !s.touch.held.left && !s.touch.held.right, vx: Math.round(s.player.body.velocity.x)}); })()
(() => { const p = game.scene.getScene('Level').player; return JSON.stringify({quickTapJumped: p.y < 470, y: Math.round(p.y), vy: Math.round(p.body.velocity.y)}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({scratched: s.player.attackReadyAt > 0}); })()
(() => { const p = game.scene.getScene('Level').player; p.setPosition(380, 360); p.setVelocity(0, 0); return 'on a platform'; })()
(() => { const p = game.scene.getScene('Level').player; return JSON.stringify({standingY: Math.round(p.y)}); })()
(() => { const p = game.scene.getScene('Level').player; return JSON.stringify({downPlusJumpDropped: p.y > 470, y: Math.round(p.y)}); })()
